newsitem.title: USA: Youth Services gets Florida contract.
newsitem.headline: Youth Services gets Florida contract.

text.p: Youth Services International Inc said on Thursday it had been picked to operate a 102-bed juvenile corrections facility in Dade County, Florida.
Florida's Department of Juvenile Justice awarded the contract, which YSI said could generate annual revenues of $3.1 million.
The corrections facility is a renovated former adult work camp in Florida City. It is due to open on November 15, YSI said.
